messages:
maria: Hey team — prospect (FinMap) is blocked on the S3-Archive vendor for the POC. They want completed CAIQ, a recent pentest report (or attestation), and encryption/network details before we can start. Timeline: they want kickoff in 2 business days. Can someone triage?

alex: On it. Can you drop the exact asks from the customer? CAIQ + pen test + encryption/network — any specific scope?

maria: Their email: "Need CAIQ responses, pen test report (last 12mo), encryption keys management (KMS/HSM), and confirmation that PII is never exfil'd to third parties. Also DPA signed." They also pointed to our prod/dedicated POC — they want assurance on isolation.

security-bot: Ticket INF-2026 created for vendor security intake (owner: alex).

taylor: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Will the vendor be storing customer logs or are they just an ingress/passthrough? 2) Is the POC in Hosted or Dedicated mode? Isolation requirements differ.

maria: Vendor will ingest logs (app + access logs) and store for 90 days. POC will run on Dedicated in their VPC (private deployment).

alex: OK — ingest + storage in customer VPC means stronger controls. For CAIQ we can reuse our vendor intake template and mark items we need from them. For pentest: we accept SOC2 Type II or an external pen test report within 12 months. If they don't have one, we can accept a signed attestation + remediation plan for critical findings and require a pen test within 90 days.

audrey: Privacy note: we need a data flow diagram and DPA before any customer data is shared. Also confirm deletion/retention controls and ability to do data subject requests.

sam: Sales asked for 48h turnaround. Is that feasible? If not, need to push kickoff.

taylor: I can draft CAIQ answers that describe Redwood's expectations and call out vendor-provided fields. But we need the vendor to fill their side for things like implementation details, KMS provider, and pentest artifacts.

alex: Draft plan: 1) Send vendor CAIQ request + DPA signature request (I can produce both). 2) Ask for latest pen test + scope or SOC2 report. 3) Request network diagram and confirmation of no shared keys / no cross-tenant access. 4) Get a statement on encryption: e.g., AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, KMS/HSM management. I'll include sample wording.

alex: ```Sample encryption answer: Data at rest: AES-256 with per-customer keys stored in vendor KMS. Data in transit: TLS1.2+ (prefer TLS1.3). KMS provider: AWS KMS / customer-managed CMK option for Dedicated. No plaintext secrets stored in logs.```

maria: If we can get the CAIQ + DPA email out today, that helps. I'll flag the timeline with the customer.

audrey: I'll review the DPA template once alex shares it. Also need the vendor to confirm subprocessor list and location of backups (are backups outside customer region?).

sam: I'll tell the customer we aim to start the POC after we get DPA & pen test/SOC2. Could you add expected ETA for responses?

alex: ETA: I'll prepare CAIQ + DPA + checklist within 6 hours. Vendor will have 48-72h to respond; if missing pen test we escalate and request attestation. Taylor will own technical follow-ups for network/keys.

taylor: I'll also add a quick checklist for the infra team: VPC peering, host-based hardening, logging retention, and RBAC matrix.

maria: Awesome — thanks. Ping me once the package is sent and I'll nudge the vendor contact. Link to draft folder: https://drive.redwood.dev/r/integrations/s3-archive/pocevidence

alex: Sent initial CAIQ request + DPA draft to vendor contact (email thread included). cc: @taylor @audrey. :+1:

maria: Vendor replied — they can provide SOC2 and KMS details but need more time for a public pentest report (they said internal tests only). I'm asking if they will sign attestation and commit to external pen test within 60 days.

alex: If they sign attestation and SOC2 covers relevant controls, we can greenlight a limited-scope POC (no production PII) behind customer VPC until pen test is complete. We'll document mitigations.

audrey: That compromise sounds acceptable if DPA is in place and no PII enters system during initial phase. Add a condition to the DPA / SOW.

maria: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and hold the kickoff until we have DPA + attestation. Will reopen thread with vendor artifacts once they arrive.
